content: src/model.ts guideFix(muse, guide, {hue}) is a pure TypeScript port of the requester's numpy texture_guide_fix.py, returning {image, darkFilled, hueFixed, maskPixels} on 0..255 RGB. It resizes Muse to the guide size, sets mask = guide R+G+B > 30, and fills dark gaps where mask and Muse R+G+B < 60 with guide*1.25 (clamped). Hue swaps replace guide*clamp(mean(Muse RGB)/max(mean(guide RGB),1), 0.7, 1.4) where the mask holds, guide saturation > 0.35, Muse saturation > 0.25, hue difference > 22 degrees, and the pixel is not dark. Saturation is (max-min)/max. Pixels outside the mask stay Muse's. It runs on the Muse picture before the existing mask cut and dilate.
guideFix's hue rule runs only when no part of the model is a marker part, because marker colours are fake. The dark-gap rule always runs when guideFix is on.

buildTextureUvPrompt in src/model.ts adds a material-colour lock when every part is base or textured with real colours and no markers. The Must not change line then names each part's colour, for example 'red rubber stays red, gold crown stays gold'. A model with a marker part gets the older Must not change line without colour names.

server.ts takes the guideFix option for image_studio_model as 'on' or 'off' (default on), and the CLI takes --guide-fix on|off. The take's manifest, record and summary carry guideFix: {darkFilled, hueFixed, maskPixels}, and the tool result reports the same counts.

tests/model-guidefix.test.ts checks guideFix on the real scepter fixtures tests/fixtures/model/scepter-guide.png (guide) and scepter-muse.webp (Muse), copied from the requester's lava-arena project. Expected counts are darkFilled 49801, hueFixed 13823, maskPixels 780480, each within 1%. The 1% tolerance covers resampling-filter differences between PIL/numpy and the TypeScript resize. The same test file has a synthetic case that checks each rule and that pixels outside the mask stay Muse's.

skills/image-studio/references/model-textures.md documents the guideFix post-processing for texture-uv, including the dark-gap rule, the hue rule and its skip for marker models, and the guideFix option.
